selection_rationale: Smallest qualifying artifact among the current released Canonical Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 products screened in candidate-matrix.json. All smaller products are unbootable root-only payloads or the audited Minimal early-storage failure. OVA, Azure VHD tar and QCOW2 are larger.
